title: Senolytics Treatment of Interstitial Lung Disease in Common Variable Immunodeficiency
off: Senolytics as a Novel Treatment for Interstitial Lung Disease in Common Variable Immunodeficiency (CVID)
conds: Interstitial Lung Disease Due to Systemic Disease
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if the supplement, Fisetin, can be used as a treatment option for common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) by comparing its efficacy to placebo.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient must have received a diagnosis of CVID according to the international consensus document (ICON) at least 30 days before enrollment.
* Physician diagnosis of possible GLILD associated with CVID.
* IgA results.
* Female patient is either not of childbearing potential, defined as postmenopausal for at least 1 year or surgically sterile. (A negative pregnancy test for women whose menopausal status is determined by self-reported absence of menstrual periods in the past 12 months will be required within 72 hours prior to randomization).
* Patient must be able and willing to comply with the requirements of this study protocol.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable or unwilling to give informed consent.
* Presence of any condition that the Investigator or the subject's attending physician believes would put the subject at risk or would preclude the patient from successfully completing the trial.
* Pregnant and/or lactating. Women of childbearing potential (WCBP) must have a negative pregnancy test within 72 hours prior to randomization.

WCBP who are unwilling to abstain from sex or use an adequate method of contraception from the time of the first IP administration through 48 hours after the last IP administration.

* Men who are unwilling to abstain from sex with WCBP or use an adequate method of contraception from the time of the first IP administration through 48 hours after the last IP administration.
* Prisoners, institutionalized individuals, or others who may be considered vulnerable populations, such as individuals with dementia.
* Patient currently hospitalized or under immediate consideration for hospitalization.
* Current use of tobacco products or as per clinical judgement.
* Current excessive caffeine intake (400 mg or more per day).

arms.d: Subjects will receive the supplement, Fisetin, for 2 cycles of 2 consecutive days (first on days 0 \& 1 and then repeated on days 28 \& 29)
Subjects will receive placebo for 2 cycles of 2 consecutive days (first on days 0 \& 1 and then repeated on days 28 \& 29)

primary.m: Change in immunophenotyping of peripheral T lymphocytes

x.titre: Fisétine dans la pneumopathie interstitielle du déficit immunitaire commun variable
x.question: La fisétine, un sénolytique, modifie-t-elle les lymphocytes T et la maladie pulmonaire interstitielle des patients atteints de DICV ?
x.contexte:
Le déficit immunitaire commun variable (DICV) est le déficit immunitaire primitif symptomatique le plus fréquent. Une partie des patients développe une atteinte pulmonaire interstitielle granulomateuse et lymphocytaire (GLILD), associée à une morbidité importante. Le traitement fait appel aux corticoïdes, au rituximab et à des immunosuppresseurs, sans standard bien établi.

Le vieillissement immunitaire accéléré, avec accumulation de cellules sénescentes et de lymphocytes T épuisés, est évoqué dans le DICV. La fisétine est un flavonoïde présenté comme sénolytique, c'est-à-dire capable d'éliminer sélectivement les cellules sénescentes. Cette phase 2 monocentrique, randomisée en double aveugle contre placebo, teste deux cures courtes de deux jours à 28 jours d'intervalle. Le critère principal est biologique : l'immunophénotypage des lymphocytes T périphériques à 6 mois.
x.interet: L'étude est exploratoire. Elle dira si une approche sénolytique modifie les marqueurs immunologiques du DICV avec GLILD, avant tout essai clinique de plus grande taille.
x.profil: Des adultes atteints de DICV avec suspicion de pneumopathie interstitielle (GLILD).
inclusion: DICV diagnostiqué selon le consensus ICON, au moins 30 jours avant l'inclusion
Femme non en âge de procréer (ménopause > 1 an ou stérilisation) avec test de grossesse si besoin
exclusion: Affection exposant à un risque ou empêchant de terminer l'essai
Apport de caféine ≥ 400 mg par jour

bras.traitement: Fisétine pendant 2 cycles de 2 jours consécutifs (jours 0-1 puis 28-29)

x.critere: Variation de l'immunophénotypage des lymphocytes T périphériques entre l'inclusion et 6 mois.
